title: 30A Ocean Pearl | KEY.co
description_expanded: - Neighborhood beach access is a short golf cart ride, not a direct walk. Dune Allen Regional Beach Access is at the end of Woodward Drive — roughly a 2-minute ride in the included golf cart, or a longer walk for those without it. - The golf cart is a rental add-on, not complimentary. The 6-seater gas cart is available at $100/day. Two bikes are included at no charge. - Three of the four bedrooms are king suites with private ensuite baths and balcony access. The fourth bedroom has a bunk/full setup with a gaming area, and two additional loft nooks sleep singles — well suited for mixed groups with kids. - Neighborhood pool access with no key or wristband required. The property has no private pool; the community pool is the only swimming option on-site. - Six porches and balconies, three of them screened in, with views over a wooded nature preserve — a genuinely quiet setting for a property this close to 30A. - No speakers or sound system provided. Pack your own if music matters to your group. - Starter kit covers the basics only (toilet paper, paper towels, pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, one bar of soap). The kitchen is described as fully stocked. KEY.co can arrange grocery delivery before arrival so you're set from day one
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Single Over Single Bunk + Double
Additional Sleeping Space (Nook 1): Single Over Single Bunk

location.address: Dune Allen Regional Beach Access is at the end of Woodward Drive and right across from Stinky's Fish Camp Restaurant. (5999 W Co Hwy 30-A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459). This beach has restrooms, parking, a lifeguard station, and is ADA accessible. A little further to the East on 30A is Fort Panic Regional Access. This beach is also ADA accessible, has parking, restrooms, and lifeguard. No Need to determine what area of the beach is assessable. Both Public Beach Accesses have plenty of space to enjoy your days on the beach.
